_about: Grimoire's own facts about the Legacy system, added to the challenges and perk trees the talentsforever export reads from the beta client. Ladders: challenges of one kind reached in order (a level 60 Warrior reached 25 and 45 first), so ticking a step ticks the steps before it. Spelunker: the dungeons each dungeon challenge lists in the game's Legacy window (Blizzard's announcement gives the level bands; one slot takes either Ragefire Chasm or the Hall of Thanes). Factions: the battleground reputations, with the VMaNGOS faction ids where the faction is Classic's. Builds: Grimoire's recommended perk plans, each a full character's points in the order to spend them (plan codes as in the planner's links).

builds.name: Leveling an alt
builds.summary: Well Rested and Talented for faster levels and talent points from level 5, then Thrill of Adventure to keep questing without stopping to drink.

builds.name: Raiding
builds.summary: Raid buffs and food that last twice as long, no vendor reagents for your class abilities, cheaper wipes and more reputation.

builds.name: Battlegrounds
builds.summary: 10% more Honor, free buffs after a resurrection, 40% less durability lost when you die and no vendor reagents.

builds.name: Crafting and gathering
builds.summary: More skill-ups, twice the Scarce materials, cheaper vendors, a skill point a day from Dedicated Study and a 15% chance of double Merchant’s Favor on crates.
